title: TREE PLANTING REQUIREMENTS
previewText: In addition to the applicable underlying street tree planting requirements, all changes of use on zoning lots having frontage on Ocean Parkway, shall provide street trees in accordance with the provisions of Section 23-611 (Street tree planting).
